description: A synthetic-only flagged occurrence has zero weight, so the canonical competing reading remains c (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest(span), late(elision)
%elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | c | d
%rule w (X [+T]) | ([+U] X)
%counts-as span
%rule missing (M N)
%rule c (X T)
%counts-as span
%rule d (X empty)
%counts-as span
%rule empty T
%counts-as span
